title: Article vs report layout
back: Article: title, by-line, hook → causes/effects → view + suggestions. Report: headline, by-line, place-date, 5 Ws → details → outcome.

title: Article = H-C-E-S
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Three paragraphs, strong last line" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="22" y="70" width="64" height="50" rx="6" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.25"/><text x="54.0" y="99.55" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Hook</text><rect x="94" y="70" width="64" height="50" rx="6" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.25"/><text x="126.0" y="99.55" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Causes</text><rect x="166" y="70" width="64" height="50" rx="6" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.25"/><text x="198.0" y="99.55" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Effects</text><rect x="238" y="70" width="64" height="50" rx="6" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.25"/><text x="270.0" y="99.55" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Solutions</text><text x="160" y="50" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">+ Title and By-line on top</text><text x="160.0" y="194" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Three paragraphs, strong last line</text></svg>
back: Hook and issue · causes and effects with examples · suggestions and a closing line. No title or by-line = format mark gone.

title: Inverted pyramid
back: Report: the 5 Ws first, then details in order with numbers, then the outcome. Most important facts at the top.

title: Report is P-P-P
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Facts, not feelings" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="40" y="60" width="70" height="50" rx="6" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.25"/><text x="75.0" y="89.9" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Past</text><rect x="125" y="60" width="80" height="50" rx="6" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.25"/><text x="165.0" y="89.55" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Passive</text><rect x="220" y="60" width="70" height="50" rx="6" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.25"/><text x="255.0" y="89.9" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">no I</text><text x="160" y="140" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">was inaugurated · were displayed · was given away</text><text x="160.0" y="194" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Facts, not feelings</text></svg>
back: Past tense, passive voice, impersonal. *The chief guest inaugurates* or *we had fun* breaks the report's voice.

title: Place, date line
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Newspaper reports begin here" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="40" y="50" width="240" height="90" rx="6"/><text x="60" y="80" text-anchor="start" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">HEADLINE IN CAPS</text><text x="60" y="98" text-anchor="start" font-size="10" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">By a Staff Reporter</text><text x="60" y="118" text-anchor="start" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Jaipur, 14 November: A two-day…</text><text x="160.0" y="194" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Newspaper reports begin here</text></svg>
back: Headline → by-line → *Place, date:* then the first sentence with what, who, when, where, why. School-magazine reports skip the place-date line.

title: Put numbers in
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="One or two figures make it credible" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="40" y="60" width="60" height="44" rx="6" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.25"/><text x="70.0" y="87.6" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">200</text><rect x="115" y="60" width="60" height="44" rx="6" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.25"/><text x="145.0" y="87.6" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">12</text><rect x="190" y="60" width="90" height="44" rx="6" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.25"/><text x="235.0" y="86.9" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">40 bags</text><text x="160" y="140" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">students · teachers · waste collected</text><text x="160.0" y="194" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">One or two figures make it credible</text></svg>
back: Participants, schools, visitors, money raised, bags of waste — a report without a number reads like a guess.

title: End the article with a line that sticks
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Call to action or hopeful line — then stop" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="40" y="40" width="240" height="60" rx="8"/><path d="M56,100 l-6,10 l14,-10"/><text x="160.0" y="55" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">A good night's sleep is the cheapest</text><text x="160.0" y="68" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">medicine we keep ignoring.</text><text x="160.0" y="194" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Call to action or hopeful line — then stop</text></svg>
back: After the suggestions, one memorable closing sentence. Describing a problem without a way forward loses content.

title: A headline, not a title
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Short, active, present tense" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="28" y="40" width="264" height="90" rx="10" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.08" stroke="currentColor"/><text x="160" y="92" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Short, active, present tense</text><text x="160" y="155" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Students clean up the riverbank</text></svg>
back: Short and active: 'Students clean up the riverbank'. Present tense in the headline, past tense in the body.
